curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: recognise wordsfeaturing the letters Bb, Rr, Uu, and Gg in written texts

mission.title: B R U G Word Hunt

interactions.prompt: Read the signs. Which word features Rr?
interactions.retryHint: Find the word beginning with r.

interactions.prompt: Sort each written word by its featured first letter.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a word, then its letter.
interactions.feedback: Great reading! You spotted all four letters.
interactions.retryHint: Look closely at the first letter of each word.

interactions.prompt: Which line contains one word with Uu and one with Gg?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Umbrella features u and goat features g.
interactions.retryHint: Search for words beginning with u and g.

interactions.prompt: Match each letter card to a word on the classroom wall.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap a letter, then its word.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence has words featuring all four letters Bb, Rr, Uu and Gg?
interactions.feedback: Excellent! Ben, runs, under and gate show the four letters.
interactions.retryHint: Find b, r, u and g at the starts of words.
